title: Can Your Mortgage Cost More Than Your House?
description: Hypothetical: a $300,000 30-year mortgage at 6.5% costs about $383K in interest, while a 15-year loan at the same rate costs about $170K. Real rates and terms vary. Educational only, not financial advice. #mortgage #personalfinance #shorts
sources: calculation: standard amortization, P=300000, r=6.5%/12; 360 mo -> $1,896.20/mo, interest $382,633; 180 mo -> $2,613.32/mo, interest $170,398

title: 217 Investors Said No. Then He Bought Starbucks
description: Howard Schultz pitched his coffee bar idea to 242 people and 217 turned him down. In 1987 he raised $3.8 million and bought Starbucks. #starbucks #entrepreneur #shorts
